title: Dad Pete Joel — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar Spanish French language learning warm baritone 106bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual family lineage rugby Australian character portrait
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Chas played. Pete played. Joel played first grade.
Same family. Same game. Different eras. Same thing underneath.
Corey found the ocean. The family needs everyone in their right form.
Federation of commanders. Each one commanding their own sphere.

[Verse 2 - Spanish, with English translations]
Chas jugó. Pete jugó. Joel jugó en primera división. (Chas played. Pete played. Joel played first grade.)
Misma familia. Mismo juego. Diferentes épocas. Lo mismo por debajo. (Same family. Same game. Different eras. Same underneath.)
Corey encontró el océano. La familia necesita a todos en su forma correcta. (Corey found the ocean. The family needs everyone in their right form.)
Federación de comandantes. Cada uno comandando su propia esfera. (Federation of commanders. Each one commanding their own sphere.)

[Chorus - French, with English translations]
Papa, Pete, Joel (Dad, Pete, Joel)
Trois hommes McIvor sur le terrain (Three McIvor men on the field)
Papa, Pete, Joel (Dad, Pete, Joel)
Le rugby dans le sang familial (Rugby in the family blood)
Papa, Pete, Joel (Dad, Pete, Joel)
La forme qu'ils portent tous (The form they all carry)
Même quand personne ne regarde (Even when no one is watching)
Papa, Pete, Joel (Dad, Pete, Joel)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Corey did not play rugby. He went to the ocean instead. The family is richer for both.
Spanish: Corey no jugó al rugby. Fue al océano. La familia es más rica por ambos. (Corey didn't play rugby. Went to the ocean. Family richer for both.)
French: Corey n'a pas joué au rugby. Il est allé à l'océan. La famille est plus riche pour les deux. (Corey didn't play rugby. Ocean instead. Richer for both.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Dad Pete Joel — the lineage is intact
Spanish: Papá Pete Joel — el linaje está intacto (Dad Pete Joel — the lineage is intact)
French: Papa Pete Joel — le lignage est intact (Dad Pete Joel — the lineage is intact)
